description: Runs ONE niche on the signed-in account and returns the new job's id at once; it does NOT wait for the video. WHEN: the user wants a format `list_niches` lists; read that niche in full first. A `plan_required` niche runs from a ready `preview_niche_script`: send its `plan_id`, no `revision` or `values`. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), never timers or background shells. No card? Give the user the `url`. COST: this spends the user's tokens. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, state the price in the same message as your ask, wait for a go naming THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES: `get_recipe` `spending-rules`). `idempotency_key`: IDEMPOTENCY (this server's instructions). The flow: `get_recipe` `niche-run`.

aspect_ratio.description: A `settings.options.aspect_ratios` value. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

audio.description: Sound on the video, where `settings.options.audio_selectable` is true. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

duration_seconds.description: One of the niche's `settings.options.durations_seconds`; longer costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

media.description: One entry per picked image or music.

input.description: The `key` of the image or music input this fills.

source.description: `preset` (`index`; music takes only this), `mine` (an image `id`) or `url` (a public https image or a `confirm_upload` url).

model.description: A `settings.options.models` value. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

resolution.description: One of the niche's `settings.options.resolutions`; higher costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

values.description: Answers by input `key`: the user's own words, or a select's `options` value (own words only where `allow_custom`).

name: generate_from_niche
title: Make a video from a niche
